A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] serving in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], this individual rose to become a '''Sith Overseer''' in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]];<ref name="Star Fortress" /> a position used not only to instruct the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolytes]] in the ways of the Sith, but also to ensure that only the most powerful students pass the trials.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, she wasn't popular among her students, one of which, [[Veeroa Denz]], thought her to be cruel. When the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Attack on Korriban|invaded]] Korriban<ref name="Star Fortress" /> in [[3636 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> and stormed the Sith Academy,<ref name="Companions & Contacts">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{C|Companions & Contacts menu}}</ref> Veeroa [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] the [[Overseer (Sith)|overseer]], using her opportunity to flee the Academy for good, becoming a fugitive.<ref name="Star Fortress" />
